headline: Colombian Peso Slides as US Dollar Touches 3,415 Amid Global Volatility
summary: The Colombian peso experienced a significant single-day depreciation, with the US dollar advancing to 3,415 pesos amid broader Wall Street equity selling and US interest rate expectations.
why: Currency weakness in Colombia raises import price inflation and elevates sovereign foreign debt servicing costs across South American emerging markets.

impacts.name: Colombian Peso
impacts.why: Broad global risk aversion pushed foreign exchange flows out of South American local currency assets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Elevated global market volatility and foreign exchange demand drove the Colombian peso lower against the dollar.
